### Highlighted patients

Two overlay groups are drawn on top of the base colouring by `highlight_points()`, which
partitions the data so no patient is plotted twice:

- **`polipo`** — sample `21S188`, in magenta.
- **`cohort`** — the multi-modal subset, in gold: patients who also have IHC or imaging
  data, and so appear in the concordance and composition reports.

`polipo` is declared first in `attend_highlight`, and matching is first-match-wins, so
`21S188` is never absorbed into `cohort`.
